breaking_changes.BC_description: SVGO v4.0.0 now requires Node.js >=16.0.0. Attempting to run SVGO with an older Node version will fail.
breaking_changes.Adaptation_method: Upgrade your Node.js runtime to version 16 or later before running SVGO.

breaking_changes.BC_description: The plugins removeViewBox and removeTitle are no longer included as default plugins in the preset-default collection. Therefore, configured runs will NOT have those plugins automatically applied.
The plugin previously named 'removeScriptElement' has been renamed to 'removeScripts'. References to the old plugin name will not work.

SVGO now enforces a strict boundary between public and internal API. You can import only declared public APIs from 'svgo' or 'svgo/browser'. Importing any other internal paths or files is no longer supported and will error.

Selector helper functions (querySelectorAll, querySelector, matches) imported from 'svgo' now require a third argument (a Map of nodes to their parent nodes) if the CSS selector references parent or sibling nodes. Omission of this argument when required will result in incorrect or broken plugin behavior.
SVGO public API now only uses named exports; default exports are no longer provided. Any code using default imports from 'svgo' must be converted to use named imports or import * as pattern.
